title: Quick Arabian Tempeh Kebabs
description: A garlicky, bouncy, plant‑based kebab with a sweet‑tangy tomato ketchup glaze that feels like a romantic middle‑east night out.
instructions: In a bowl toss tempeh, bell pepper, zucchini, onion, and garlic with olive oil, cumin, paprika, lemon juice, salt, and pepper; let marinate for 5 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated pieces onto skewers, leaving a small gap between each.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, brushing with ketchup every 2 minutes.
Continue cooking until the vegetables are tender and tempeh is lightly charred.
Remove from grill, drizzle with a thin layer of ketchup, and garnish with fresh parsley if desired.
Serve immediately with a side of couscous or flatbread for a complete meal.
